results.bound: \exists \text{ connected unweighted graph } G \text{ on } n \text{ vertices with } \rho(G)=r, \forall 1\le r\le r_{\mathrm{BP}}(n)
results.quote: Theorem 1.2. _For every_ \(n\ge 1\) _and every integer_ \(1\le r\le r_\mathrm{BP}(n)\)_, there is a connected unweighted graph on n vertices whose Max-Cut semidefinite relaxation has a unique optimal solution of rank r._

results.bound: \max_{G \text{ connected unweighted on } n \text{ vertices}} \rho(G) = r_{\mathrm{BP}}(n)
results.quote: Corollary 1.3. _For every_ \(n\ge 1\)_, the maximum of_ \(\rho(G)\) _over connected unweighted graphs on n vertices equals r_<sub>BP</sub>(_n)._

results.problem: Max-Cut semidefinite relaxation optimal rank for random graphs
results.bound: \rho(G) \ge c \left(\frac{n}{(\log n)^3}\right)^{1/7} \text{ with probability tending to } 1
results.quote: Theorem 6.1. _There is an absolute constant c\)>0 _such that, for_ \(G\sim G(n,\frac{1}{2})\), \(\mathbb{P}\big\{\rho(G)\ge c\left(\frac{n}{(\mathrm{log}n)^3}\right)^{1/7}\big\}\longrightarrow 1.\)
